svg.text: A server on every node, one owner per discussion
The owner runs the turns and writes the files; the other nodes keep read-only copies
Mac: agent-room server
Discussion B: OWNER
runs the turns, starts its CLIs, writes the files
(locally, or on another node via SSH or Rex)
Discussion A: read-only copy
your messages are forwarded to A's owner
Pi: agent-room server
Discussion A: OWNER
keeps going while the Mac sleeps
Discussion B: read-only copy
out of date while the Mac is offline
owner → copies
Moving a discussion ("teleport") = handing over its ownership
1 old owner finishes the current turn and pauses 2 last files reach the new node 3 new owner confirms and starts fresh agents
The hard case: the owner disappears mid-round (lid closed)
• Safe: wait, and hand over ownership when the Mac comes back. The discussion is paused until then.
• Automatic: a time-limited ownership claim (a "lease"); when it expires, another node takes over, and the old owner's late
writes are rejected when it wakes up. This is where the size and complexity grow.
Not proposed: several nodes writing the same discussion at once (that needs consensus algorithms; far too big for agent-room).
